items.title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models

Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer. To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations. items.summary: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, making it better aligned with human-AI collaborative creation than single-turn editing. However, constructing high-quality multi-turn training data remains challenging, as conventional sequential rollout accumulates errors and introduces visual-quality drift across editing turns. items.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
items.summary: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. items.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
items.summary: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong design intelligence: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes. In this work, we introduce Scene-Designer, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences. items.summary: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. items.summary: Long-horizon agents often struggle to recover from failures whose causes lie several steps earlier, beyond what local reflection or backtracking can resolve. items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model by supervising a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy, but its supervision remains confined to the output space. Consequently, OPD transfers what a teacher predicts without supervising the intermediate computation that produces those predictions. items.summary: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. items.summary: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. items.summary: Reliable deployment of LLM-based multi-agent systems calls for runtime auditors that predict terminal outcomes from observed execution prefixes. These auditors typically learn from a limited corpus of trajectories with verified outcomes. Expanding this corpus requires costly execution and verification, yet broader failure coverage alone provides no explicit criterion for identifying prefixes that the current auditor finds difficult to classify. items.summary: AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can keep scientific experiments running for months with little human supervision, but reliable autonomous research also requires scientific judgment. Evaluating scientific judgment is difficult because research decisions are open-ended and depend on project context. We construct SciΠvot, a 248-case benchmark of scientific judgment based on human corrections. items.summary: Progress toward general intelligence in the physical world requires scaling robot learning across diverse environments and interactions. However, existing robot policies use shared parameters that remain fixed across interaction contexts. When different operations favor competing parameter adjustments, fitting their mixture can leave individual operations insufficiently adapted. items.summary: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly couple video and action experts through dense, layer-wise Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, exposing action prediction to irrelevant visual features while enforcing matched expert depths. items.summary: Retrieval is a fundamental task in multimodal systems: given an image or text query, the goal is to find the most relevant images or texts in a collection, often using a shared embedding space. Reliable retrieval requires these embeddings to capture not only which concepts are present, but also how they are composed. One key compositional challenge is attribute--object binding: encoding which attributes belong to which objects. items.summary: Peer review is under strain from the growth of submissions, and review comments written by humans or AI can misstate what a paper says. items.summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) receive image-generation supervision that exposes them to visual information not fully documented in text. Can learning to generate images expand what pretrained models know? items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. items.summary: Generated videos often lose geometric consistency under camera motion: structures warp under viewpoint change, parallax becomes inconsistent, and smooth camera movement may collapse into shot-like transitions. We argue that this failure is largely a data problem. In web-scale video corpora, most visible motion comes from dynamic objects captured by static or weakly moving cameras, leaving only sparse supervision for viewpoint-induced appearance changes. items.summary: Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. items.summary: Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. items.title: 12.88万起、华为电驱+L4同源智驾，Ray7能成为埃安年轻化的答卷吗？
items.summary: 10月17日，埃安轿跑Ray7正式开启预售，预售价12.88 万起。新车车长4.9米，轴距2.9米，车头部分搭配3.25米的超长双环灯带，是埃安10年焕新的家族式标识。 新车采用宁德时代电池以及广汽自研的弹匣电池2.0技术，能够在充分释放续航能力的同时，监控电池健康状态。提供45.58kWh和62.98kWh两种规格，续航可达702公里，整车风阻系数 Cd 低至 0.22。 Ray7搭载华为DriveONE多合一电驱，以及华为DriveONE芯片级驱制融合架构，百公里制动仅为32.8米。 底盘方面，Ray7搭载高性能前后稳定杆和后五连杆悬架，过弯极限更高，滤振更干净。 智能化上， Ray7搭载27颗车规级全视角传感器，采用文远知行L4级Robotaxi同源大模型。这帮助新车能够复用 L4 积累的海量场景经验，在城区掉头、绕行等复杂场景中可顺利通行。 自2025年广汽推进“番禺行动”以来，昊铂埃安BU的研发、生产、销售等环节效率不断提升，产品迭代和新车投放节奏明显加快。作为埃安全新Ray车系的首款新车，Ray7是埃安开启年轻化序列的关键落子，也是广汽切入20万级市场的重要布局。 这一细分市场竞争并不轻松：小鹏P7、极氪007等车型已经提前卡位。Ray7想在年轻人心中占位，不能只堆参数，更要把智能座舱与辅助驾驶、三电安全、补能效率、用车成本和价格权益上的差异，变成用户可感、可信、可持续…

items.title: 双11 iPhone Duo平台大战，比的就是货源，记者实测：只有苹果官网、天猫可下单
items.summary: 双11 iPhone duo 平台大战，比的就是货源。10 月 16 日消息，苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 今日 20:00 正式开售，首批货源迅速售罄，多家电商平台的官方旗舰店入口一度出现卡顿。 截至 21:30，记者实测发现，目前仅苹果官网与苹果天猫官方旗舰店仍可下单，最早的一批于天猫双11开卖日10月20日后3天发货（10月23日）。社交媒体晒单显示，苹果天猫官方旗舰店在短时间内补货6次，发货时间分别为：11月7日、11月14日、11月21日、11月28日、12月5日等。当前，苹果官网显示iPhone duo发货时间已排期至2027年1月23日。 与此同时，iPhone Duo 已出现在二手交易平台，部分卖家报价较官方售价高出近万元。相关消息引发网友讨论。有网友表示，与其加价购买，不如等待后续补货；也有人调侃，官网虽然还能下单，但排期已经到了明年，“折叠手机买出了期货的感觉”。 还有网友准备先观察首批用户的耐用性反馈，再决定是否入手。

今天开车被迫窝囊了一次
items.summary: 开车等红灯，还剩三四十秒时，前车往前跑了一段，空了大概十几米距离。我没动，准备快变灯时再起步过去。 这时候后面车开始滴滴滴打喇叭，我想着反正红灯又走不了，就没理他。随后他一个猛拐，从左车道饶过我去前面了，我还是没在意，又走不了，你想塞就塞呗。 此时我前面有两辆车。绿灯亮了，大家正常起步，我跟在后面。这时有意思的事情发生了：前车压上斑马线后，突然一个急刹不动了，过了四五秒，又挪了一下，随后又是一脚刹停。 我一下子明白了，感情这是报复我来了。就这样，他一直卡到黄灯才走。我这时还比较淡定，只是随口骂了句 SB ，心想：这不是给我送证据让我举报吗？装了这么久的海康威视行车记录仪终于要派上用场了。我还特意瞄了眼时间，方便后面找视频。 下车时，我把内存卡拔了下来，带回家，翻出尘封已久的读卡器，连上电脑。然后就傻眼了：这特么什么情况？怎么那个时间段一个视频都没有？要说坏了，但是后面还有新的视频，卡也没满啊？ 不死心，又翻了几遍其它目录，最后确定没有。不过倒是发现了一个规律：这记录仪好像每次只会记录起步和停车的几分钟，中间全是空的？不是哥们，这科学吗？ 这下子尴尬了，本以为能重拳出击呢，没想到小丑竟是我自己，只能窝囊忍着了。 给 V 友们丢脸了 😭

items.title: 备孕 2 年，最后试管生下健康女儿，分享一下经历，顺带吐槽一下深圳市妇幼。
items.summary: ## 大概时间线： 1. 2023 年 9 月开始备孕，本来我老婆想晚几年的，我说可以先试试，怕有问题可以及早干预，结果一语成谶。。。 2. 2024 年 7 月发帖咨询 v 友[https://v2ex.com/t/1055069#reply265]，表面是能放松下来，但实际内心还是没法真正放松吧。因为一直没有优势卵泡，所以还是选择去医院促排，时间点都得安排好，也就没去旅游 3. 2024 年底发现近半年每次排卵的那一侧输卵管间质部堵塞，难怪怀不上，然后做了个疏通手术。医生说效果很好，还好不是因为炎症导致的堵塞，不然会反复堵上。 4. 2025 年初才真正开始具备怀孕条件（有优势卵泡且输卵管通畅），而且近一年我早睡，加上经常跳绳，公司买了升降桌没有久坐，精子质量好了一点，结果还是没怀，于是想试试人授，又折腾半年后，结果还是没怀上，最后想到我年纪也不小了，不想再等了，于是两人一致决定直接试管。 5. 2025 年 9 月第一次试管，做的是一代，促排、取卵、胚胎培养、鲜胚移植，一次就成功了，也算幸运。 6. 怀孕期间没有任何不适，产检一路绿灯，孕晚期我老婆走路走得比我还快😂 7. 2026 年 7 月，宝贝女儿出生，7 斤 2 两，侧切，母女平安。（因为孕晚期有一个月天天吃番薯，而且一天吃了很多东西，导致孩子在那一个月体重激增。） ## 前期备孕 多次促排、3 次人授在深圳市妇幼福…

items.title: 发现大家对拖欠工资这件事接受度很高
items.summary: 入职现在的公司已经差不多 4 年，每个月准时发工资，节假日提前发。 这个月突然说资金周转不过来，工资需要拖一下，最快月底会发，实际上去年年终奖金也拖到现在快年底了，也还没发，估计是泡汤了。 但我发现同事们对这件事，基本上就是打趣一两句公司是不是不行了，然后就闭嘴不谈了，每天还是热火朝天的干活，开会，讨论需求，特别积极。 我真有点理解不了他们的动力是从哪里来的，我上班 8 年 从来没遇到过拖欠工资的，明显这公司也快到头了，我看情况再过一两月最多过完年肯定得撤了，目前很摆，什么周报的直接不写。 虽然我也明白这改变不了什么，但只能说还是很不爽吧。

items.title: [送激活码] 我做了一个跟随 Finder 窗口的路径工具 FinderNav，送 80 个激活码
items.summary: 🎉 FinderNav for macOS 开启首轮公开测试！ 大家好，我是 FinderNav 的开发者。 在深层目录里切换祖先目录、返回刚才访问的位置、复制文件路径或在终端中打开当前目录时，Finder 的这些入口比较分散。 所以我做了 **FinderNav** —— 一款原生的 macOS Finder 增强工具。 它不会替代 Finder ，也不会修改 Finder 本身，而是跟随当前 Finder 窗口，在底部增加一条轻量的悬浮导航栏，把路径导航和常用文件操作集中在随手可及的位置。 Finder 自带的路径栏主要用于展示和跳转； FinderNav 在此基础上加入了收藏、最近访问、Quick Access 、路径复制、终端打开和文件操作，并会跟随当前 Finder 窗口。 ![FinderNav 界面预览]( https://static-cjys.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/FInderNav/738e7cd1-3ba8-475e-bc2b-54f8835379b6.png) ### 路径面包屑导航 FinderNav 会显示当前 Finder 窗口所在的完整路径。点击任意一级目录，就能直接跳转，不再需要一层层返回。 ### 收藏与最近访问 常用文件夹可以直接收藏；刚刚访问过的路径也会自动记录，方便快速回到之前的位置。 收藏、历史和设置…
